definitions.ja: 祝福、恵み（文化的・宗教的用語）
definitions.km: ពរ (ពាក្យវប្បធម៌/សាសនា)
definitions.th: พร (คำทางวัฒนธรรม/ศาสนา)
definitions.vi: Phước lành, lời chúc (thuật ngữ văn hóa/tôn giáo)

lao_examples.lao_script: ຂໍໃຫ້ພອນແມ່ຢູ່ນຳລູກ.
lao_examples.romanization: khɔ̌ː hȁj pʰɔ́ːn mɛ̄ː jūː nám lûːk
lao_examples.translation_en: May mother's blessing be with you, my child.

lao_examples.lao_script: ປີໃໝ່ຂໍໃຫ້ທຸກຄົນໄດ້ຮັບພອນດີ.
lao_examples.romanization: piː mɑ̄j khɔ̌ː hȁj tʰūk kʰōn dȁj hāp pʰɔ́ːn diː
lao_examples.translation_en: For the New Year, may everyone receive good blessings.
